text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, postal address, phone number, and payment information when you register for an account.
risk_reason: Standard collection of necessary user account details for service operation.
recommendation: Normal operational requirement. Ensure you provide accurate contact details.

text: We automatically collect precise geolocation data from your mobile device continuously, even when the application is closed or not in active use.
risk_reason: Continuous background location surveillance poses severe privacy intrusions and device battery drain.
recommendation: Revoke background location permissions in your device settings.

text: We may collect biometric identifiers including facial geometry, voiceprints, and keystroke dynamics to authenticate your account and train machine learning models.
risk_reason: Biometric data cannot be changed if breached, posing irrevocable identity theft risks.
recommendation: Review biometric consent laws in your jurisdiction or decline optional biometric features.

text: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal identifiable information to third parties for monetary consideration.
risk_reason: Protective clause explicitly restricting monetization of user personal data.
recommendation: Consumer protective provision.

text: We reserve the right to share, sell, lease, or license your personal information, browsing history, and purchase records with advertising partners and data brokers.
risk_reason: Allows commercial exploitation and distribution of your private browsing and identity records to unknown brokers.
recommendation: Submit an opt-out request under CCPA/GDPR if available, or avoid providing sensitive personal details.

text: We may disclose your information to trusted third-party service providers solely to perform payment processing, cloud hosting, and customer support on our behalf.
risk_reason: Standard operational sub-processing necessary to deliver the requested service.
recommendation: Normal operational clause. Verify that providers are bound by confidentiality.

text: Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle at the standard non-promotional rate unless you cancel at least 48 hours prior to renewal.
risk_reason: Automatic renewals can result in unexpected recurring credit card charges if you miss the cancellation window.
recommendation: Set a calendar reminder several days before the trial or billing period ends.

text: All subscription fees and purchases made through the service are strictly non-refundable under any circumstances, including service outages or early account termination.
risk_reason: Denies statutory consumer rights to refunds even when the service is defective or unavailable.
recommendation: Consider paying via credit cards that offer merchant chargeback dispute protections.

text: You may cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings page, and cancellation will take effect at the conclusion of your current billing period.
risk_reason: Clear, self-service cancellation process without deceptive retention dark patterns.
recommendation: Fair consumer policy.

text: IN NO EVENT SHALL THE COMPANY BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR ANY LOSS OF PROFITS OR REVENUES.
risk_reason: Standard corporate disclaimer shifting downstream commercial risks and indirect losses entirely onto the user.
recommendation: Standard commercial terms, but be aware company disclaims liability for data loss.

text: OUR TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THESE TERMS SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF FIFTY DOLLARS ($50) OR THE AMOUNT YOU PAID IN THE PAST MONTH.
risk_reason: Caps maximum monetary recovery to an insignificant amount ($50) even if the company's gross negligence causes major financial injury.
recommendation: High risk for business or mission-critical use of the service.

text: The company may suspend or terminate your account immediately at any time, for any reason or no reason, without notice and without liability to you.
risk_reason: Enables unilateral deletion of your account and user data without explanation, warning, or recourse.
recommendation: Keep regular offline backups of any important content stored on the platform.

text: We will provide you with at least thirty (30) days advance notice before terminating your account for convenience, allowing you an opportunity to export your data.
risk_reason: Fair clause providing adequate warning and data retrieval rights before termination.
recommendation: Equitable and transparent provision.

text: YOU AND THE COMPANY AGREE THAT ANY DISPUTE RESOLUTION PROCEEDINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED ONLY ON AN INDIVIDUAL BASIS AND NOT IN A CLASS, CONSOLIDATED OR REPRESENTATIVE ACTION.
risk_reason: Strips consumers of the ability to join class action lawsuits to collectively remedy widespread micro-harms or deceptive practices.
recommendation: Check if an arbitration opt-out notice can be mailed within 30 days of registration.

text: Any controversy or claim arising out of these Terms shall be settled by binding arbitration in accordance with the commercial arbitration rules of the American Arbitration Association.
risk_reason: Forces disputes out of public courtrooms into private arbitration tribunals, often far from the consumer's domicile.
recommendation: Look for an opt-out mechanism usually detailed in the arbitration section.

text: By submitting or posting content to the platform, you grant us an irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, transferable license to use, reproduce, modify, and distribute your content.
risk_reason: The platform claims permanent ownership-like exploitation rights over user-created works even after account cancellation.
recommendation: Do not post proprietary, copyrighted, or sensitive creative work if you wish to retain exclusive rights.

text: You retain all intellectual property rights in your user content, and you grant us only a limited license strictly necessary to host and display the content to your selected audience.
risk_reason: Respects user copyright and only requests functional permissions required to run the service.
recommendation: Fair and protective copyright terms.

text: We may modify these Terms at any time without notice, and your continued use of the service constitutes immediate and binding acceptance of all modifications.
risk_reason: Allows the vendor to secretly alter contract obligations, privacy standards, or prices without informing you.
recommendation: Check the agreement version date periodically or use terms-monitoring browser tools.

text: We will notify you of any material changes to these Terms via email or prominent site banner at least 30 days prior to the changes taking effect.
risk_reason: Fair notification policy giving users reasonable advance notice to review or decline changes.
recommendation: Ensure your registered email address is active to receive change notices.

text: We retain your personal data indefinitely, even following deletion of your account, for analytics, compliance, and our own business development purposes.
risk_reason: Permanent retention of user records creates perpetual data breach exposure and denies the right to be forgotten.
recommendation: Submit a formal GDPR / CCPA erasure request upon deleting your account.

text: Upon account deletion, we purge all personal identifiers from our primary production databases within thirty (30) days.
risk_reason: Provides a definite timeline for removing personal records upon account termination.
recommendation: Transparent and privacy-respecting.

text: We may monitor, record, and transcribe your private direct messages, voice calls, and customer interactions using automated speech-to-text algorithms.
risk_reason: Direct surveillance of private communications violates basic consumer confidentiality expectations.
recommendation: Use end-to-end encrypted messaging alternatives for sensitive conversations.

text: All payments are processed securely through certified PCI-DSS compliant third-party payment gateways, and we do not store full credit card numbers on our servers.
risk_reason: Adheres to industry standard security safeguards for payment card information.
recommendation: Protective industry practice.

text: You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the company, its officers, and affiliates from any third-party claims, liabilities, or legal fees arising from your use of the service.
risk_reason: Obligates the user to pay legal defense bills and damage judgments for the company if a third party sues.
recommendation: Standard in B2B agreements, but potentially burdensome for individual consumers.

text: You must be at least 18 years of age, or the age of legal majority in your jurisdiction, to create an account and agree to these Terms.
risk_reason: Standard legal capacity requirement to enter into contracts.
recommendation: Verify compliance with local age requirements.

text: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.
risk_reason: Standard legal jurisdiction clause specifying applicable legal framework.
recommendation: Informative; determines which state laws interpret the contract.

text: We use tracking pixels, web beacons, and persistent browser fingerprinting to track your activity across third-party websites outside of our domain.
risk_reason: Builds comprehensive behavioral profiles by tracking online activities across unrelated third-party websites.
recommendation: Use privacy-focused browsers or anti-tracking browser extensions.

text: If any provision of these Terms is found to be unlawful, void, or unenforceable, that provision will be deemed severable and will not affect the validity of the remaining provisions.
risk_reason: Standard boilerplate clause preserving the rest of the contract if one part is deemed invalid.
recommendation: Standard contractual boilerplate.

text: We may charge your payment method a non-refundable administrative reactivation fee of up to $75 if your account is temporarily suspended for non-payment.
risk_reason: Imposes punitive administrative fees that may not have been highlighted during sign-up.
recommendation: Monitor payment methods to avoid accidental failed transaction penalties.

text: You agree that we may access, scan, and review your cloud storage files and uploaded attachments for content moderation and algorithmic improvement.
risk_reason: Violates expectations of personal cloud storage privacy by scanning file contents.
recommendation: Encrypt sensitive files client-side before uploading to cloud storage.
